_comment: Panel-local extras per app folder. 'setup' is a one-shot post-start script run with the app folder as cwd.

setup.label: Run WordPress setup
setup.hint: Installs WP core, activates the Çınar theme and seeds pages/projects (1-2 min, idempotent).

setup.label: Create Strapi admin
setup.hint: Creates admin@tarla.dev / Admin123! inside the running cms container (idempotent).

setup.label: Run Ghost setup
setup.hint: Creates the owner account, activates the Sığınak theme and seeds posts (idempotent). Wait until health is green first.

setup.label: Run Directus bootstrap
setup.hint: Creates collections, public permissions and seed events (idempotent). Wait until health is green first.
